_about: The failure signatures of a build-feature run end, read by classify-failure.js (owner decision 2026-10-20, D13).
Ordered (not by id): the first signature whose `when` holds wins. `when` keys, all of which must hold:
status: run statuses; nodes: the number of nodes the run started; failed_node / failed_node_not: the first failed
node is (not) one of these; failed_kind: its kind (agent, loop, exec, gate); merged: the merged node completed;
text: a regex (case-sensitive) that matches the run's whole error text, or any failed node's own error;
tdd_only: every `TDD:` line of the error matches this regex; output: {node, match}, a node's output matches;
facts: {name: value}, facts the classifier gathered (see classify-failure.js); seen: the run had this signature
before (in the recovery state); any: a list of `when`, one of which holds.
action is resume | repair | park | ask | none; step names the mechanical work recover-run.sh does for it.
variants: the first whose `if` facts hold replaces action/step (and reason, when it names one). budget: attempts
per signature and step for one run (null: no limit). delays: seconds after the run ended before attempt n. breaker:
counts (2 runs in 60 min open it), immediate (one opens it) or exempt. ping: now | digest | no. quiet_wait: a
wait on a red main never turns into a ping of its own (merge-ready.sh pings a red main once per SHA).

signatures.reason: the main checkout blocked the fast-forward; sync-main.sh, then a new launch (the run has no nodes to resume)
the launch failed before any node ran, for a reason no script repairs
a person stopped the run
the pull request merged and only the tail failed: cleanup-merged.sh, then commit-tickets.sh when ticket edits are left

when.text: is closed\. Only draft pull requests

signatures.reason: the pull request was closed under the run; merged means finish outside the run, closed unmerged means park

any.text: GitHub still reports [0-9a-f]+ as the head of #\d+

variants.reason: the pull request is closed but the run's branch is not merged: reopen it (gh pr reopen), or park the ticket
the run's branch has a commit origin does not: push it if it belongs to the ticket, or move it off the branch

signatures.reason: CI waited for GitHub to show the run's head on the pull request; pushed, GitHub was late and a resume 10 min after the end goes on

when.text: no test agent window found[\s\S]*no red/step-\d+\.log

signatures.reason: steps were folded into one build step without the plan's fold markers, so skill-check finds no red log for them: add the markers, then resume
a transient model or network error

any.text: No CI run for this commit

signatures.reason: no CI status on the head: run local CI on it, then resume
the run asks a question: answer it from written sources (answer-blocked.sh), else park it
the implement loop ran out of rounds with no BLOCKED: line; resume it (never adopt or relaunch)

when.tdd_only: changes a test file|changes code with no test commit before it|\d+ problem\(s\)

signatures.reason: only the commit shape is wrong; the shape fix rewrites unpushed commits with the tree unchanged (D12)

when.text: step \d+ is not done|has no red test run|shows no failing test

signatures.reason: a step or its failing test is missing: work a person judges
a skill was never loaded or a file was hand-written where a template fits
the push lost a race with origin; rebase the run's branch and resume
main is red on a job that also fails on the head; launch nothing, rebase and resume once main is green
ci-fix made no commit on a red pull request head: red-triage first (a listed flake gets its one rerun), still red parks
ci-fix ran out of rounds on a red the branch caused

when.text: cannot tell which commit|a quote in the argument|usage:|did not parse|JSON Parse error|command not found|Permission denied|unbound variable

signatures.reason: a script or node defect: park, tell the maintainer; after a script fix rebase-and-resume, after a YAML-only fix a new run
main-ci failed after the merge: wait for a green main, then resume so main-ci and the close-out run again
finalize held the ticket (close=false) and close-out was skipped, yet the run shows completed
the merge commit has no CI result; run local CI on it (a red result opens the breaker)
completed cleanly
no known signature matches: a person decides
